panels.title: Gesamt-Traffic — Allzeit
panels.description: Gesamter übertragener Traffic seit Beginn der Aufzeichnung — kein Zeitfilter.

targets.query: SELECT SUM(bytes_in + bytes_out) AS value FROM openvpn_session
targets.rawSql: SELECT SUM(bytes_in + bytes_out) AS value FROM openvpn_session

targets.query: SELECT SUM(bytes_in + bytes_out) AS value FROM openvpn_session WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
targets.rawSql: SELECT SUM(bytes_in + bytes_out) AS value FROM openvpn_session WHERE $__timeFilter(time)

targets.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM openvpn_session WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM openvpn_session WHERE $__timeFilter(time)

panels.title: Nutzer Gesamt — Allzeit
panels.description: Distinct CNs mit mindestens einer Session.

targets.query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT common_name) AS value FROM openvpn_session
targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT common_name) AS value FROM openvpn_session

targets.query: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('day', time) AS time, SUM(bytes_in) AS "Bytes In", SUM(bytes_out) AS "Bytes Out" FROM openvpn_session WHERE $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('day', time) ORDER BY time
targets.rawSql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('day', time) AS time, SUM(bytes_in) AS "Bytes In", SUM(bytes_out) AS "Bytes Out" FROM openvpn_session WHERE $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('day', time) ORDER BY time

targets.query: SELECT common_name AS "Nutzer", SUM(bytes_in + bytes_out) AS "Traffic" FROM openvpn_session WHERE $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY common_name ORDER BY SUM(bytes_in + bytes_out) DESC LIMIT 10
targets.rawSql: SELECT common_name AS "Nutzer", SUM(bytes_in + bytes_out) AS "Traffic" FROM openvpn_session WHERE $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY common_name ORDER BY SUM(bytes_in + bytes_out) DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Monatlicher Traffic — Gesamte Historie
panels.description: Kein Zeitraum-Filter — zeigt immer alle Monate seit Aufzeichnungsbeginn.

targets.query: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', time) AS time, SUM(bytes_in) AS "Bytes In", SUM(bytes_out) AS "Bytes Out" FROM openvpn_session GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', time) ORDER BY time
targets.rawSql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', time) AS time, SUM(bytes_in) AS "Bytes In", SUM(bytes_out) AS "Bytes Out" FROM openvpn_session GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', time) ORDER BY time

targets.query: SELECT time AS "Zeitpunkt", common_name AS "Nutzer", real_ip AS "Real IP", virtual_ip AS "VPN IP", duration_s AS "Dauer (s)", bytes_in AS "Bytes In", bytes_out AS "Bytes Out" FROM openvpn_session WHERE $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 200
targets.rawSql: SELECT time AS "Zeitpunkt", common_name AS "Nutzer", real_ip AS "Real IP", virtual_ip AS "VPN IP", duration_s AS "Dauer (s)", bytes_in AS "Bytes In", bytes_out AS "Bytes Out" FROM openvpn_session WHERE $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 200
